[Explore Close calling](https://close.com/calling) [Explore Close AI](https://close.com/ai) [Explore integrations](https://close.com/integrations)

The power dialer in Close working through the High Priority Leads list, then the call it connects with Steve Hall of Brightpine Foods: the live transcript lands on the lead record as they talk, and the AI Notetaker writes the notes.

The Agents page in Close: the Closed-lost Re-engagement Agent runs its weekly job — finds 27 eligible leads, reviews each history, writes 27 re-engagement drafts and creates 3 review tasks — then reports 16 actions, 27 drafts and 3 tasks, with the first three drafts ready to review.

The Sales Pipeline in Close: deals land in their stages — Demo Completed, Proposal Sent, Contract Sent — each stage with its count and annualized value. "Needs attention" is switched on, the deals that are fine drop away, and the three left get a follow-up suggestion each: draft an email and schedule a call with Reynolds & Wareham, text Loftwork Studio, call Prestancia Group.

Close's MCP server inside four apps in turn: ChatGPT answers what Closed Lost leads had in common, Claude creates 18 follow-up tasks in Close, VS Code writes a pipeline report from 24 open opportunities, and Grok preps a sales call from a lead's emails, calls and deal in Close.

## Frequently asked questions

What is the Close Partner Program?

The Close Partner Program helps agencies, CRM consultants, affiliates, creators, technology companies, and startup organizations grow their businesses with Close CRM. Partners can earn referral commissions, offer implementation and consulting services, build integrations and AI sales workflows, and access resources to help customers succeed.

Who can become a Close partner?

Close works with several types of partners:

-   **Agencies and Solution Partners:** Earn referral commissions and build businesses around consulting, migrations, automation, and ongoing services.
-   **Affiliates and Creators:** Earn commissions by recommending Close to an audience or professional network.
-   **Technology Partners:** Build integrations, applications, and AI workflows using Close's API and MCP capabilities.
-   **VCs, Accelerators, and Incubators:** Help portfolio companies establish and scale their sales processes with Close.

Can I join if I already work with HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Salesforce?

Yes. You can add Close to your CRM services portfolio without giving up your existing partnerships, subject to any obligations under those programs. [Close is a strong option](https://close.com/why-close) to recommend, particularly for growing sales teams that rely on calling, email, SMS, and automation to connect with prospects and close deals.

Does Close require professional implementation?

No. Close is designed to be easy to set up and use without a dedicated CRM administrator. Partners can help clients get even more value through migrations, consulting, automation, integrations, and training.

How can agencies and consultants earn money with Close?

Agencies and consultants can generate revenue through migrations, sales process consulting, training, integrations, workflow automation, AI Agent implementation, and ongoing optimization. Eligible partners can also earn commissions for referring new Close customers.

How much commission do Close partners earn?

Eligible Close partners can earn up to 30% commission on qualifying first-year subscription revenue from referred customers. Commissions depend on eligible revenue and the terms of your partner agreement. Agencies and consultants can also charge customers separately for consulting and ongoing services.

Can partners build AI Agents and integrations with Close?

Yes. Close provides [API and MCP capabilities](https://developer.close.com/) that partners can use to create integrations, custom workflows, and AI sales solutions. Partners can help customers automate lead qualification, follow-up, sales activities, and other processes, creating opportunities for ongoing consulting services.

What support do Close partners receive?

Close partners can access product expertise, technical guidance, sales enablement, and resources to help customers succeed. Depending on eligibility and partner type, additional opportunities may include co-marketing, Marketing Development Funds (MDF), and visibility through the Close partner ecosystem.

How do I become a Close partner?

Complete the application on this page and select your preferred partnership type. The application takes approximately two minutes. Our Partnerships team typically responds within one to two business days to discuss your business, partnership opportunities, and next steps.
